summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Nouveau Monde Graphite Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnishing its condensed consolidated interim unaudited financial statements and management's discussion and analysis for the three-month period ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes financial statements, certifications, and a consent. It contains no disclosure of any special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change. The filing is purely a periodic financial report with no transactional or special-situations content.
